title: Exponential growth of square-plus-one orbits
plain: Show square-plus-one sequences, when they don't loop, grow at a steady exponential rate in the number of digits.
math: Prove that for almost every $n$ (density 1), $\lim_{k}\frac1k\log\log Q^k(n)$ exists and equals a constant $\gamma>0$; identify $\gamma$.
